name: Iron Bear Resources Ltd
summary: Iron Bear Resources Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Australia. The company explores for nickel, lithium, iron, copper, platinum group elements, and gold deposits. Its flagship project is the Iron Bear iron ore project located in the Labrador Trough, Canada. The company was formerly known as Cyclone Metals Limited and changed its name to Iron Bear Resources Ltd in January 2026. Iron Bear Resources Ltd was incorporated in 2000 and is based in West Leederville, Australia.
